claims.status_note: author explained focus is on memory reduction, reviewer tested ACKed

claims.status_note: author updated commits and reviewer gave tested ACK

claims.text: Witnesses constructed from vectors with elements larger than MAX_SIZE throw when read and terminate the process inside noexcept accessors

claims.status_note: author updated branch and reviewer gave tested ACK

claims.text: Include SpanReader construction inside the try blocks to drop extra scopes in the fuzz test

claims.status_note: author updated commits and reviewer gave tested ACK

claims.text: Cast spans to unsigned char in operator== to enable optimized comparisons

claims.text: Start deserialization from a populated witness in tests to verify that reading an empty stack clears it
